title: SYBAU
blurb: Four letters doing a remarkable amount of heavy lifting in comment sections everywhere. SYBAU stands for something considerably less polite than 'please stop talking', and it became the brainrot era's favourite conversation ender precisely because it is faster to type than the sentence it replaces. Anyone under twenty parses it instantly; anyone over thirty has to look it up and then wishes they had not. Deploy it when a discussion has clearly run its course, or when somebody replies to a joke with a correction nobody wanted.
origin: A viral Gen Alpha acronym used to shut down conversations.
